facts.fact: The Treasury sheet says the tax system E-TAX was built in-house by the ministry's information systems directorate.

note: Only reports expired software licences at the finance ministry IT directorate; not who runs or builds a system.

facts.fact: The finance ministry reports that on 22 July 2025 it installed 5 service heads, 7 project heads and 6 assistants in its information systems directorate, several seconded from ACSI, to lead systems including SIGFIP, SIPAE, SYSPACE and SFEC.
